title: Desk Training Module on Undocumented Outside Dose Entries and Series Positions
content:
# Desk training — undocumented outside dose entries and series positions

Under Immunization Services, cash-paid dose entries recorded from another provider without a lot number hold positions in a series by a rule of their own, which bears on the dose number a screening and consent form covers on a series that continues an earlier course of the same vaccination.

## The rule the desk applies

Cash-paid entries recorded from another provider without a lot number hold positions as follows.

- Where a documented outside entry also exists — a cash-paid entry recorded from another provider that **carries** a lot number — each undocumented entry holds **0** positions.
- Where no documented outside entry exists and Kestrel reported a dose of the earlier course to the state registry, the undocumented entries together hold **1** position: one between them however many there are, and none when there are none.
- Where no documented outside entry exists and Kestrel reported no dose, each undocumented entry holds a position.

## Questions answered

**What makes an outside entry "undocumented" here?** It is a dose entry that names no Kestrel store, was paid in cash, and carries no lot number.

**What counts as a documented outside entry?** A dose entry that names no Kestrel store, was paid in cash, and carries a lot number.

**Which record is read first?** The documented outside entry. If one is on the earlier course, the undocumented entries hold 0 positions whether or not Kestrel reported a dose.

**How is "Kestrel reported a dose" read?** From the earlier course's history: at least one entry showing Kestrel reported a dose to the state immunization registry.

| Documented outside entry on the earlier course | Registry report on it | Positions held by the undocumented entries |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | At least one | 0 each |
| Yes | None | 0 each |
| No | At least one | 1 between them (0 when there are none) |
| No | None | 1 each |

## Hypothetical casebook

*Every figure in these cases is a hypothetical training input.*

1. The earlier course holds one documented outside entry and two undocumented entries; one registry report is on its history. The two undocumented entries hold 0 positions.
2. The earlier course holds no documented outside entry, three undocumented entries and one registry report. The three entries hold 1 position between them.
3. The earlier course holds no documented outside entry, two undocumented entries and no registry report. They hold 2 positions, one each.
